points.name: Kocher's point (R)
points.note: Frontal burr hole for ventricular access / EVD (approximate).

points.name: Keen's point (R)
points.note: Parietal access to the atrium of the lateral ventricle (approximate).

points.name: Dandy's point (R)
points.note: Occipital access to the occipital horn (approximate).

points.name: Anterior commissure — AC (stereotactic landmark)
points.note: Anterior commissure crossing in the anterior wall of the third ventricle (~27 mm anterior to PC); anterior anchor of the Talairach/Schaltenbrand AC–PC intercommissural reference line (MNI ICBM152 ~[0, +2, −4] mm).
points.surg: Primary midline reference for indirect AC–PC stereotactic targeting (MCP lies halfway along the AC–PC line). Schematic atlas coordinate only — never for clinical targeting.
points.ref: Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL Atlas); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Posterior commissure — PC (stereotactic landmark)
points.note: Posterior commissure at the dorsal aspect of the superior entrance to the cerebral aqueduct; posterior anchor of the AC–PC intercommissural reference plane (MNI ICBM152 ~[0, −25, −2] mm).
points.surg: Used alongside AC and the midline sagittal plane to establish patient-specific stereotactic coordinates; injury causes Parinaud dorsal midbrain syndrome. Schematic coordinate only.
points.ref: Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL Atlas); StatPearls NBK441892.

points.name: Subthalamic nucleus — STN sweet spot (R)
points.note: Dorsolateral sensorimotor zone of the right subthalamic nucleus (MNI ICBM152 consensus ~[+12, −14, −6.5] mm; ~12 mm lateral, 2 mm posterior, 4–5 mm inferior to MCP).
points.surg: Principal DBS target in medication-refractory Parkinson disease (rigidity, bradykinesia, tremor, levodopa dose reduction). Toggle 'Projection, commissural & cerebellar tracts' to see its relationship medial to the corticospinal tract / internal capsule. Schematic only — not for clinical targeting.
points.ref: Horn et al., Ann Neurol 2017; Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Subthalamic nucleus — STN sweet spot (L)
points.note: Dorsolateral sensorimotor zone of the left subthalamic nucleus (MNI ICBM152 consensus ~[−12, −14, −6.5] mm).
points.surg: Principal DBS target in Parkinson disease; ventromedial spread into limbic/associative STN or oculomotor fibres is avoided during test stimulation. Schematic only — not for clinical targeting.
points.ref: Horn et al., Ann Neurol 2017; Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Globus pallidus internus — GPi posteroventral (R)
points.note: Posteroventral sensorimotor territory of the right internal globus pallidus (MNI ICBM152 consensus ~[+20.5, −6, −4.5] mm; ~20 mm lateral, 2–3 mm anterior, 3–4 mm inferior to MCP).
points.surg: Primary DBS target for generalised/cervical dystonia and Parkinson disease with severe dyskinesia or cognitive vulnerability. Bounded medially by the internal capsule and inferiorly by the optic tract. Schematic only.
points.ref: Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Globus pallidus internus — GPi posteroventral (L)
points.note: Posteroventral sensorimotor territory of the left internal globus pallidus (MNI ICBM152 consensus ~[−20.5, −6, −4.5] mm).
points.surg: Primary DBS target for dystonia and dyskinesia-predominant Parkinson disease; phosphenes on test stimulation verify proximity to the underlying optic tract. Schematic only.
points.ref: Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Ventral intermediate thalamus — Vim (R)
points.note: Cerebellar-receiving ventral intermediate nucleus of the right thalamus, traversed by the dentatorubrothalamic tract (MNI ICBM152 ~[+14, −16.5, +1] mm; ~13–15 mm lateral, ~6 mm anterior to PC at AC–PC level).
points.surg: Standard DBS and MR-guided focused ultrasound (MRgFUS) target for essential tremor and tremor-dominant Parkinson disease. Toggle 'Projection, commissural & cerebellar tracts' to inspect DRTT intersection. Posterior spread into Vc causes paraesthesia; lateral spread into capsule causes dysarthria/contraction. Schematic only.
points.ref: Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Ventral intermediate thalamus — Vim (L)
points.note: Cerebellar-receiving ventral intermediate nucleus of the left thalamus along the dentatorubrothalamic tract (MNI ICBM152 ~[−14, −16.5, +1] mm).
points.surg: Target for contralateral upper-limb essential tremor (DBS or MRgFUS thalamotomy); bilateral lesioning/stimulation carries elevated gait and speech risk. Schematic only.
points.ref: Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 (DISTAL); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Anterior nucleus of thalamus — ANT (R)
points.note: Right anterior thalamic nuclear group at the superior-medial aspect of the thalamus within the Papez circuit (MNI ICBM152 ~[+5.5, −6, +11] mm).
points.surg: FDA/CE-approved DBS target for drug-resistant focal epilepsy (SANTE trial). Transventricular and extraventricular trajectories must avoid the thalamostriate vein, choroid plexus, and internal cerebral veins. Schematic only.
points.ref: Fisher et al., Epilepsia 2010 (SANTE); Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018.

points.name: Anterior nucleus of thalamus — ANT (L)
points.note: Left anterior thalamic nuclear group within the Papez circuit (MNI ICBM152 ~[−5.5, −6, +11] mm).
points.surg: Targeted bilaterally in refractory temporal/limbic epilepsy DBS. Schematic only.
points.ref: Fisher et al., Epilepsia 2010 (SANTE); Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018.

points.name: Centromedian–parafascicular complex — CM-Pf (R)
points.note: Right intralaminar centromedian–parafascicular thalamic complex (MNI ICBM152 ~[+8.5, −19.5, +0.5] mm).
points.surg: Neuromodulation target in Lennox–Gastaut / generalised epilepsy (ESTEL trial) and refractory Tourette syndrome. Schematic only.
points.ref: Warren et al., Ann Neurol 2022 (ESTEL); Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018.

points.name: Centromedian–parafascicular complex — CM-Pf (L)
points.note: Left intralaminar centromedian–parafascicular thalamic complex (MNI ICBM152 ~[−8.5, −19.5, +0.5] mm).
points.surg: Neuromodulation target in generalised epilepsy and Tourette syndrome. Schematic only.
points.ref: Warren et al., Ann Neurol 2022 (ESTEL); Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018.

points.name: Nucleus accumbens / ventral capsule — NAcc (R)
points.note: Right ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens shell–core junction beneath the anterior limb of the internal capsule (MNI ICBM152 ~[+8.5, +10.5, −7.5] mm).
points.surg: Investigational/humanitarian-exemption DBS target in severe treatment-refractory obsessive-compulsive disorder (VC/VS, ALIC, NAcc) and psychiatric neuromodulation. Schematic only.
points.ref: Pauli et al., Sci Data 2018 (CIT168); StatPearls NBK557847.

points.name: Nucleus accumbens / ventral capsule — NAcc (L)
points.note: Left ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens beneath the anterior limb of the internal capsule (MNI ICBM152 ~[−8.5, +10.5, −7.5] mm).
points.surg: Targeted bilaterally in treatment-refractory OCD neuromodulation along frontostriatal (anterior thalamic radiation) bundles. Schematic only.
points.ref: Pauli et al., Sci Data 2018 (CIT168); StatPearls NBK557847.

attribution: SPL-PNL Brain Atlas (3D Slicer License). Cite: spl.harvard.edu/publications/item/view/1265
HCPex: github.com/wayalan/HCPex; HCP-MMP1 (Glasser et al. 2016).
White-matter tracts: JHU ICBM-DTI-81 (Mori/Hua/Wakana; FSL).
Arterial territories: Liu et al., Scientific Data 2023 (CC BY-SA 4.0), doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01923-0.
Cytoarchitecture: Juelich histological atlas (Eickhoff et al.; FSL).

MNI brain shell: ICBM152 2009c (mni.mcgill.ca). Entry-point and stereotactic DBS target markers (consensus MNI152 coordinates after Ewert et al., NeuroImage 2018 DISTAL / Horn et al., Ann Neurol 2017 / Pauli et al., Sci Data 2018 CIT168) are schematic teaching approximations, never for clinical planning.
SPL Head and Neck Atlas (Jakab & Kikinis, SPL/Brigham; 3D Slicer License part B). Underlying CT: MANIX dataset, OsiriX DICOM library.
Craniotomy footprints are schematic approximations computed on the skull surface for teaching; not for planning or navigation.

Pathology case: UPenn-GBM cohort (Bakas et al., Scientific Data 2022;9:453), The Cancer Imaging Archive, CC BY 4.0. Scans de-identified and de-faced at source; only lesion meshes and a brain surface skull-stripped in-house (no scalp or face) are redistributed here. NIfTI derivatives curated via the Pittsburgh Fiber Data Hub (data-nih/tcia).
Molecular case library: UCSF-PDGM (Calabrese et al., TCIA, doi:10.7937/tcia.bdgf-8v37, CC BY 4.0); NIfTI derivatives via the Pittsburgh Fiber Data Hub (data-nih/tcia).

Vestibular schwannoma: Vestibular-Schwannoma-SEG (Shapey, Kujawa et al.), TCIA, CC BY 4.0. Tumour and cochlea contours only — patient skull contours deliberately excluded to avoid any re-identifiable surface.
Spine: Spine-Mets-CT-SEG, TCIA, CC BY 4.0. Vertebral segmentations only.

Approaches specimen: composite teaching model. Skull, neck vessels and cervical spine from the SPL Head and Neck CT atlas; brain structures from the SPL-PNL atlas registered into that skull; white-matter tracts (JHU) and intracranial arteries (Mouches & Forkert, Sci Data 2019;6:29, CC0 vessel atlas, doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0034-5) mapped from MNI space. Dural sinuses, flaps, corridors, incisions and trajectories are schematic.

Tracts & cranial nerves layer and Approaches-specimen tracts: HCP-1065 population-averaged tractography atlas, Yeh FC, Nature Communications 2022;13:4933, doi:10.1038/s41467-022-32595-4 (brain.labsolver.org). CC BY-SA 4.0. Meshes derived from the atlas NIfTI masks (smoothed and decimated).
Reference illustrations adapted (resized) from Servier Medical Art (https://smart.servier.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Fibre dissection specimen: BraDiPho (Brain Dissection Photogrammetry), Fondazione Bruno Kessler and collaborators — Vavassori L, Rheault F, Nocerino E, et al. "Brain dissection photogrammetry: a tool for studying human white matter connections integrating ex vivo and in vivo multimodal datasets." Nat Commun 2025;16:9801. https://bradipho.eu — licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Specimen 19 (left hemisphere): 12 photogrammetric dissection stages, manual SLS bundle annotations, and HCP842/SCIL tractography registered to the specimen by the BraDiPho team. Adapted here: meshes decimated, textures downsampled, annotations painted onto the stage surfaces, tract envelopes reconstructed from the streamline meshes. The adapted file bradipho_spc19.glb is shared under the same CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence.

Skull bones specimen (skull_bones.glb): BodyParts3D 4.0 — BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International (Mitsuhashi N, et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2009). Adapted: bones recoloured and assembled; suture bands and craniometric keypoints computed from bone contacts in this model (keyhole placed by rule). Shared under CC BY 4.0.

Cadaveric plates: Courtesy of the Rhoton Collection, American Association of Neurological Surgeons (AANS)/Neurosurgical Research and Education Foundation (NREF). From the “Rhoton Collection Top 100” slide set (images by Albert Rhoton, Jeffrey Sorenson, Kaan Yagmurlu, Maria Peris-Celda, Marjorie Wang, Adriano Garcia-Scaff, Toshiro Katsuta, Carolina Martins; editing by Jeffrey Sorenson, Carl Heilman; supported by the NREF Rhoton Fund). Re-used for education under the Rhoton Collection terms (https://nref.org/education/The-Rhoton-Collection/); watermarks retained; images resized only, outline overlays redrawn from the slide set. Commercial or non-educational use requires permission from NREF. Videos: https://www.youtube.com/@RhotonCollection

Cerebral venous system overlay (venat_veins.glb): VENAT 7T Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping venous atlas, Huck J, Wanner Y, Fan AP, et al., Hum Brain Mapp 2019; figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.7205960. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

Subcortical, brainstem & deep cerebellar nuclei overlay (deep_nuclei_mni.glb) and cerebellar lobules (suit_cerebellum.glb): CIT168 700 µm reinforcement learning subcortical atlas (Pauli WM, Nili AN, Tyszka JM, Sci Data 2018;5:180063, CC BY 4.0); Harvard Ascending Arousal Network (AAN) Atlas v2.0 (Edlow BL et al., Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.zw3r228d2, CC0); Levinson–Bari NTS brainstem atlas (Levinson S et al., Sci Data 2023); and SUIT cerebellar lobule & deep nuclei atlas (Diedrichsen J et al., NeuroImage 2009/2011, github.com/DiedrichsenLab/cerebellar_atlases, CC BY-NC-SA).

Temporal bone & otic capsule specimen (openear_temporal.glb): OpenEar 3D human temporal bone library (ALPHA specimen, 125 µm CBCT + micro-slicing histology), Sieber D, Erfurt P, John S, et al., Sci Data 2019;6:180297, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.1473724. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

Spinal cord & white-matter tracts specimen (pam50_spinal_cord.glb): PAM50 multimodal spinal cord and white-matter tract template (C3–C7 cervical enlargement crop), De Leener B, Fonov VS, Collins DL, et al., NeuroImage 2018;165:170–179 (Spinal Cord Toolbox, github.com/spinalcordtoolbox/PAM50). Licensed MIT.

Circle of Willis & variants specimen (circle_of_willis.glb): TopCoW (Topology-Aware Anatomical Segmentation of the Circle of Willis for CTA and MRA, subjects IXI012, IXI013, IXI034 & Tr0088), Yang K, Musio F, Ma Y, et al., Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.15692630 (IXI MRA CC BY-SA 3.0 / TopCoW educational research release).

Intracranial saccular aneurysms specimen (case_aneurysms.glb): Derived de-identified vascular and aneurysm surface meshes from the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm 26-Class Segmentation open educational dataset (huggingface.co/datasets/spc819/rsna2025-aneurysm-26class-seg); only vessel and aneurysm lumen contours are redistributed (no facial, skull or raw DICOM data).

Meningioma library (case_library_meningioma.glb) & Paediatric CNS tumour library (case_peds_tumours.glb): ASNR-MICCAI BraTS Pre-operative Meningioma (LaBella D et al., Sci Data 2024) and BraTS-PEDs Paediatric Tumour (Kazerooni AF et al.) de-identified, skull-stripped NIfTI segmentations, licensed CC BY 4.0. Only derived lesion contours and a skull-stripped reference brain surface (no scalp, skull or facial features) are redistributed.

Brain metastases & longitudinal SRS specimen (case_brain_mets.glb): PROTEAS longitudinal brain metastasis dataset (Diagnostic and follow-up MRIs, CTs, Radiotherapy and Radiomics data of Brain Metastases, subjects P05, P12, P14), Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.17253793, licensed CC BY 4.0. Only lesion masks and a skull-stripped brain mask are redistributed.

Right-hemisphere fibre dissection specimen (bradipho_spc12.glb): BraDiPho Specimen 12 (right hemisphere, 12 photogrammetric Klingler dissection stages + co-registered SLS tractography), Vavassori L, Rheault F, Nocerino E, et al., Nat Commun 2025;16:9801, https://bradipho.eu — licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike). Adapted meshes and reconstructed tract envelopes are shared under the same CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence.
